parent.match: Match each car brand to the company that owns it.
parent.odd: Three of these car brands are owned by {value}. Which one isn't?
parent.all: Tap all {n} car brands owned by {value}.

rows.label: Porsche
rows.description: German automobile manufacturer specializing in high-performance sports cars, SUVs and sedans, owned by Volkswagen AG
rows.hook: builds the rear-engined 911 sports car with a crest featuring a prancing horse

rows.label: Audi AG
rows.description: German automotive manufacturing subsidiary of Volkswagen Group
rows.hook: uses a badge of four interlocking rings and the slogan "Vorsprung durch Technik"

rows.label: Lexus
rows.description: Japanese brand of luxury vehicle owned by Toyota Motor Corporation
rows.hook: was launched as a luxury line to take on European rivals in the American market

rows.label: Chevrolet
rows.hook: sells the Corvette and Camaro and wears a golden bowtie badge

rows.label: Cadillac
rows.hook: is the classic American luxury badge, famed for 1950s tail fins and the Escalade SUV

rows.label: Opel
rows.description: German automobile manufacturer, subsidiary of Stellantis
rows.hook: wears a lightning bolt badge and built the Corsa and Astra for European drivers

rows.label: Bentley
rows.hook: makes hand-built luxury grand tourers with a winged "B" badge

rows.label: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars
rows.hook: makes ultra-luxury limousines topped with the Spirit of Ecstasy hood ornament

rows.label: Maserati
rows.hook: puts a trident badge on Italian luxury sports cars like the GranTurismo

rows.label: Citroën
rows.hook: uses a double-chevron badge and built the quirky 2CV "Deux Chevaux"

rows.label: Buick
rows.description: luxury car brand of General Motors
rows.hook: sells mid-size luxury SUVs with a tri-shield badge and is especially popular in China

rows.label: Vauxhall
rows.description: English car company, subsidiary of Stellantis
rows.hook: sells the Corsa and Astra in Britain under a griffin badge

rows.label: SEAT
rows.description: Spanish automotive company based in Martorell, subsidiary of Volkswagen Group
rows.hook: is Spain's best-known car marque, with the Ibiza and Leon hatchbacks

rows.label: Lincoln Motor Company
rows.description: luxury division of Ford Motor Company
rows.hook: is the luxury badge behind the Continental and the Navigator SUV, long used for presidential limousines

rows.label: Alpine
rows.hook: is a French sports car marque famous for its blue rally cars and the lightweight A110

rows.label: Daihatsu
rows.hook: specializes in tiny, fuel-sipping kei cars for Japan's crowded streets

rows.label: DS Automobiles
rows.description: French premium car marque of Stellantis
rows.hook: is a French premium marque, spun off as an upscale line with avant-garde styling
